## Background

Every 3-D rotation can be described in multiple equivalent ways. This tool converts between the five most common representations and visualises the underlying screw axis in 3-D. Full derivations live in the [Rotation Representations Reference](rotation-representations-reference.html).

| Representation | Parameters | Key property |
|---|---|---|
| Rotation matrix $R \in SO(3)$ | 9 numbers | $R^\top R = I$, $\det R = +1$ |
| Quaternion $\mathbf{q} = (w, x, y, z)$ | 4 numbers | $|\mathbf{q}| = 1$; double cover of $SO(3)$ |
| ZYX Euler angles $(\psi, \theta, \phi)$ | 3 numbers | Yaw-pitch-roll; gimbal lock at $\theta = \pm 90°$ |
| Axis-angle $(\hat{\mathbf{n}}, \theta)$ | 4 numbers | Rodrigues formula; undefined axis at $\theta = 0$ |
| Exponential coordinates $\boldsymbol{\omega} = \theta\hat{\mathbf{n}}$ | 3 numbers | Lie algebra $\mathfrak{so}(3)$; $|\boldsymbol{\omega}| = \theta$ |

::: {.callout-note}
## Provenance
The Rodrigues formula, quaternion algebra, and ZYX Euler extraction follow Park & Lynch, *Modern Robotics*, Cambridge University Press, 2017, Chapters 3–4.
All conversion functions implement the same algorithms as the Python reference in [Rotation Representations Reference](rotation-representations-reference.html).
:::

---

```{=html}
<!-- ── Scripts ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
     rotation-converter.js is the pure math engine (no DOM dependencies).
     Three.js and OrbitControls are loaded from CDN for the 3-D visualiser.
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── -->
<script src="../js/rotation-converter.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.165.0/build/three.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.165.0/examples/js/controls/OrbitControls.js"></script>

<script>
/* ─── Rotation Converter UI ────────────────────────────────────────────────
 *
 * Responsibilities:
 *   1. Read active-panel inputs  →  parse  →  call RotationConverter.convert()
 *   2. Write all other panels with the results
 *   3. Show validation badges, gimbal-lock warning, and properties
 *   4. Show step-by-step formula text
 *   5. Drive the Three.js screw axis visualiser
 *
 * State: `activeRep` — which panel was last edited (drives the convert call).
 * ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
(function () {
  "use strict";

  const RC = window.RotationConverter;

  /* ── State ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  let activeRep  = "eulerZYX";   // last-edited representation
  let angleDeg   = true;         // true = display/input angles in degrees
  let currentResult = null;      // last successful convert() output

  /* ── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
  const fmt = (n, d = 6) => Number(n).toFixed(d);
  const fmtAngle = rad => angleDeg ? fmt(RC.rad2deg(rad), 4) : fmt(rad, 6);
  const parseAngle = str => {
    const v = parseFloat(str);
    return angleDeg ? RC.deg2rad(v) : v;
  };

  /* ── Status bar ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function showStatus(msg, type = "info") {
    const el = $("rc-status");
    el.style.display = "block";
    el.style.background = type === "error" ? "#fef2f2" : "#f0fdf4";
    el.style.color      = type === "error" ? "#991b1b" : "#166534";
    el.style.border     = `1px solid ${type === "error" ? "#fca5a5" : "#86efac"}`;
    el.textContent = msg;
    if (type !== "error") setTimeout(() => { el.style.display = "none"; }, 3000);
  }

  /* ── Angle-unit toggle ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  document.querySelectorAll('input[name="rc-units"]').forEach(radio => {
    radio.addEventListener("change", () => {
      angleDeg = radio.value === "deg";
      if (currentResult) populateAllPanels(currentResult);
      updateAngleLabels();
    });
  });

  function updateAngleLabels() {
    const unit = angleDeg ? "°" : "rad";
    document.querySelectorAll(".rc-aa-angle-lbl").forEach(el => {
      el.textContent = `θ (${unit})`;
    });
    ["psi","theta","phi"].forEach(c => {
      const el = $(`rc-lbl-${c}`);
      if (el) el.textContent = el.textContent.replace(/\(°\)|\(rad\)/, `(${unit})`);
    });
  }

  /* ── Read helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function readMatrix() {
    const R = [];
    document.querySelectorAll(".rc-matrix-cell").forEach(inp => {
      R.push(parseFloat(inp.value) || 0);
    });
    return R;    // length-9 row-major
  }

  function readQuaternion() {
    const q = [0,0,0,0];
    document.querySelectorAll(".rc-q-cell").forEach(inp => {
      q[parseInt(inp.dataset.comp)] = parseFloat(inp.value) || 0;
    });
    return q;
  }

  function readEuler() {
    const vals = {};
    document.querySelectorAll(".rc-euler-cell").forEach(inp => {
      vals[inp.dataset.comp] = parseAngle(inp.value);
    });
    return { psi: vals.psi || 0, theta: vals.theta || 0, phi: vals.phi || 0 };
  }

  function readAxisAngle() {
    const vals = {};
    document.querySelectorAll(".rc-aa-cell").forEach(inp => {
      vals[inp.dataset.comp] = parseFloat(inp.value) || 0;
    });
    const rawAxis = [vals.nx, vals.ny, vals.nz];
    const axisNorm = RC.norm3(rawAxis);
    const axis = axisNorm > 1e-12 ? rawAxis.map(v => v / axisNorm) : [0, 0, 1];
    const angle = parseAngle(String(vals.angle));
    return { axis, angle };
  }

  function readExpCoord() {
    const w = [0,0,0];
    document.querySelectorAll(".rc-exp-cell").forEach(inp => {
      w[parseInt(inp.dataset.comp)] = parseFloat(inp.value) || 0;
    });
    return w;
  }

  /* ── Write helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function writeMatrix(R, skipFocus) {
    document.querySelectorAll(".rc-matrix-cell").forEach(inp => {
      const idx = parseInt(inp.dataset.row) * 3 + parseInt(inp.dataset.col);
      inp.value = fmt(R[idx]);
    });
    updateRValidity(R);
  }

  function writeQuaternion(q) {
    document.querySelectorAll(".rc-q-cell").forEach(inp => {
      inp.value = fmt(q[parseInt(inp.dataset.comp)]);
    });
    const norm = Math.sqrt(q.reduce((s,v)=>s+v*v,0));
    $("rc-q-validity").textContent = `‖q‖ = ${fmt(norm,8)}`;
    $("rc-q-validity").style.color = Math.abs(norm-1) < 1e-5 ? "#059669" : "#dc2626";
  }

  function writeEuler(euler) {
    document.querySelectorAll(".rc-euler-cell").forEach(inp => {
      inp.value = fmtAngle(euler[inp.dataset.comp]);
    });
    const gl = euler.gimbalLock;
    const el = $("rc-euler-validity");
    if (gl) {
      el.style.color = "#d97706";
      el.textContent = "⚠ Gimbal lock — pitch = ±90°. ψ and φ cannot be independently resolved; φ set to 0.";
      $("rc-row-gimbal").style.display = "table-row";
      $("rc-prop-gimbal").textContent = "⚠ Gimbal lock: ZYX pitch = ±90°. Use quaternion or exponential coords for interpolation.";
    } else {
      el.textContent = "";
      $("rc-row-gimbal").style.display = "none";
    }
  }

  function writeAxisAngle(aa) {
    const { axis, angle } = aa;
    ["nx","ny","nz"].forEach((c, i) => {
      document.querySelector(`.rc-aa-cell[data-comp="${c}"]`).value = fmt(axis[i]);
    });
    document.querySelector('.rc-aa-cell[data-comp="angle"]').value = fmtAngle(angle);
    const el = $("rc-aa-validity");
    if (Math.abs(angle) < 1e-8) {
      el.textContent = "θ ≈ 0: identity rotation. Axis direction is arbitrary.";
      el.style.color = "#6b7280";
    } else {
      const n = RC.norm3(axis);
      el.textContent = `‖n̂‖ = ${fmt(n,8)}`;
      el.style.color = Math.abs(n-1) < 1e-5 ? "#059669" : "#dc2626";
    }
  }

  function writeExpCoord(omega) {
    document.querySelectorAll(".rc-exp-cell").forEach(inp => {
      inp.value = fmt(omega[parseInt(inp.dataset.comp)]);
    });
    const mag = RC.norm3(omega);
    $("rc-exp-validity").textContent = `|ω| = ${fmtAngle(mag)} ${angleDeg?"°":"rad"} (= rotation angle θ)`;
    $("rc-exp-validity").style.color = "#059669";
  }

  function updateRValidity(R) {
    const { valid, detError, orthogError } = RC.validateR(R);
    const el = $("rc-R-validity");
    el.textContent = valid
      ? `✓ Valid SO(3): det error=${detError.toExponential(1)}, ‖RᵀR−I‖∞=${orthogError.toExponential(1)}`
      : `✗ Not valid SO(3): det error=${detError.toExponential(2)}, ‖RᵀR−I‖∞=${orthogError.toExponential(2)}`;
    el.style.color = valid ? "#059669" : "#dc2626";
  }

  /* ── Properties panel ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function updateProperties(result) {
    const { R, axisAngle, quaternion } = result;
    const { axis, angle } = axisAngle;
    const { valid, detError, orthogError } = RC.validateR(R);
    const det = 1 - detError;   // approximate
    const qnorm = Math.sqrt(quaternion.reduce((s,v)=>s+v*v,0));

    $("rc-prop-angle").textContent = `${fmtAngle(angle)} ${angleDeg?"°":"rad"}`;
    $("rc-prop-axis").textContent  =
      Math.abs(angle) < 1e-8 ? "(identity — axis undefined)" :
      `[${axis.map(v=>fmt(v,4)).join(", ")}]`;
    $("rc-prop-det").textContent   = fmt(1 - detError + (RC.validateR(R).detError), 8);
    $("rc-prop-orth").textContent  = orthogError.toExponential(2);
    $("rc-prop-qnorm").textContent = fmt(qnorm, 8);

    // Recompute det properly
    const [r] = [R];
    const detR = r[0]*(r[4]*r[8]-r[5]*r[7]) - r[1]*(r[3]*r[8]-r[5]*r[6]) + r[2]*(r[3]*r[7]-r[4]*r[6]);
    $("rc-prop-det").textContent = fmt(detR, 8);
  }

  /* ── Formula text panel ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function buildFormulaText(result, fromRep) {
    const { R, quaternion: q, axisAngle: aa, eulerZYX: eu, expCoord: ow } = result;
    const { axis, angle } = aa;
    const lines = [];
    const th = fmtAngle(angle);
    const unit = angleDeg ? "°" : " rad";

    lines.push(`Source representation: ${fromRep}`);
    lines.push("─".repeat(50));

    if (fromRep === "axisAngle" || fromRep === "expCoord") {
      lines.push("Rodrigues formula (axis-angle → R):");
      lines.push("  R = I + sin(θ)·[n̂]× + (1−cos θ)·[n̂]×²");
      lines.push(`  θ = ${th}${unit},  n̂ = [${axis.map(v=>fmt(v,4)).join(", ")}]`);
    }
    if (fromRep === "quaternion") {
      lines.push("Quaternion → R:");
      lines.push("  R = I·(w²−|v|²) + 2vvᵀ + 2w[v]×  (abbreviated)");
      lines.push(`  q = [${q.map(v=>fmt(v,6)).join(", ")}]`);
    }
    if (fromRep === "eulerZYX") {
      lines.push("ZYX Euler → R:  R = Rz(ψ)·Ry(θ)·Rx(φ)");
      lines.push(`  ψ = ${fmtAngle(eu.psi)}${unit}`);
      lines.push(`  θ = ${fmtAngle(eu.theta)}${unit}${eu.gimbalLock?" ← GIMBAL LOCK":""}`);
      lines.push(`  φ = ${fmtAngle(eu.phi)}${unit}`);
    }
    if (fromRep === "R") {
      lines.push("R → axis-angle:");
      lines.push("  θ = arccos((tr(R)−1)/2)");
      lines.push(`  θ = arccos((${fmt(R[0]+R[4]+R[8],4)}−1)/2) = ${th}${unit}`);
      lines.push("  n̂ = (1/2sinθ)·[R₃₂−R₂₃, R₁₃−R₃₁, R₂₁−R₁₂]ᵀ");
    }

    lines.push("");
    lines.push("R → quaternion:  w = ½√(1+tr(R)),  (x,y,z) = 1/(4w)·[R₃₂−R₂₃, R₁₃−R₃₁, R₂₁−R₁₂]");
    lines.push(`  Result: q = [${q.map(v=>fmt(v,6)).join(", ")}]`);

    lines.push("");
    lines.push("R → ZYX Euler:  ψ = atan2(R₂₁,R₁₁),  θ = −arcsin(R₃₁),  φ = atan2(R₃₂,R₃₃)");
    lines.push(`  Result: ψ=${fmtAngle(eu.psi)}${unit}, θ=${fmtAngle(eu.theta)}${unit}, φ=${fmtAngle(eu.phi)}${unit}`);

    lines.push("");
    lines.push("Exponential coords:  ω = θ·n̂");
    lines.push(`  ω = [${ow.map(v=>fmt(v,6)).join(", ")}],  |ω| = ${fmt(RC.norm3(ow),6)}`);

    $("rc-formula-text").textContent = lines.join("\n");
  }

  /* ── Master update ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function update() {
    let input, fromRep;
    try {
      switch (activeRep) {
        case "R":         input = readMatrix();    fromRep = "R";         break;
        case "quaternion": input = readQuaternion(); fromRep = "quaternion"; break;
        case "eulerZYX":  input = readEuler();     fromRep = "eulerZYX";  break;
        case "axisAngle": input = readAxisAngle();  fromRep = "axisAngle"; break;
        case "expCoord":  input = readExpCoord();   fromRep = "expCoord";  break;
      }

      // Normalise quaternion before passing to convert
      if (fromRep === "quaternion") {
        const n = Math.sqrt(input.reduce((s,v)=>s+v*v,0));
        if (n < 1e-12) throw new Error("Quaternion is zero — cannot normalize");
        input = input.map(v => v/n);
      }

      const result = RC.convert(input, fromRep);
      currentResult = result;

      // Update all panels EXCEPT the active one
      if (fromRep !== "R")          writeMatrix(result.R);
      if (fromRep !== "quaternion") writeQuaternion(result.quaternion);
      if (fromRep !== "eulerZYX")   writeEuler(result.eulerZYX);
      if (fromRep !== "axisAngle")  writeAxisAngle(result.axisAngle);
      if (fromRep !== "expCoord")   writeExpCoord(result.expCoord);

      // Always update validity on active panel too
      if (fromRep === "R")         updateRValidity(result.R);
      if (fromRep === "eulerZYX")  writeEuler(result.eulerZYX);  // for gimbal

      updateProperties(result);
      buildFormulaText(result, fromRep);
      updateViz(result);

      // Highlight active panel
      document.querySelectorAll(".rc-panel").forEach(p => p.classList.remove("rc-panel-active"));
      const panelMap = { R: "rc-panel-R", quaternion: "rc-panel-q",
                         eulerZYX: "rc-panel-euler", axisAngle: "rc-panel-aa",
                         expCoord: "rc-panel-exp" };
      const activePanel = document.getElementById(panelMap[fromRep]);
      if (activePanel) activePanel.classList.add("rc-panel-active");

    } catch (err) {
      showStatus(`Error: ${err.message}`, "error");
    }
  }

  /* ── Populate all panels from a result object (e.g. after unit toggle) ─── */
  function populateAllPanels(result) {
    writeMatrix(result.R);
    writeQuaternion(result.quaternion);
    writeEuler(result.eulerZYX);
    writeAxisAngle(result.axisAngle);
    writeExpCoord(result.expCoord);
    updateProperties(result);
    buildFormulaText(result, activeRep);
  }

  /* ── Wire up all input events ───────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function wireInputs(selector, rep) {
    document.querySelectorAll(selector).forEach(inp => {
      inp.addEventListener("input", () => {
        activeRep = rep;
        update();
      });
    });
  }
  wireInputs(".rc-matrix-cell", "R");
  wireInputs(".rc-q-cell",      "quaternion");
  wireInputs(".rc-euler-cell",  "eulerZYX");
  wireInputs(".rc-aa-cell",     "axisAngle");
  wireInputs(".rc-exp-cell",    "expCoord");

  /* ── Load buttons (the ↑ Use this … buttons) ────────────────────────────── */
  document.querySelectorAll(".rc-load-btn").forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
      activeRep = btn.dataset.rep;
      update();
      showStatus(`Loaded from ${btn.dataset.rep} panel.`);
    });
  });

  /* ── Preset buttons ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  const PRESETS = {
    identity:  { rep: "axisAngle", data: { axis:[0,0,1], angle:0 } },
    rx90:      { rep: "axisAngle", data: { axis:[1,0,0], angle: Math.PI/2 } },
    ry90:      { rep: "axisAngle", data: { axis:[0,1,0], angle: Math.PI/2 } },
    rz90:      { rep: "axisAngle", data: { axis:[0,0,1], angle: Math.PI/2 } },
    rz180:     { rep: "axisAngle", data: { axis:[0,0,1], angle: Math.PI } },
    arbitrary: { rep: "axisAngle", data: { axis:[1/Math.sqrt(3),1/Math.sqrt(3),1/Math.sqrt(3)], angle: 47.3*Math.PI/180 } },
    gimbal:    { rep: "eulerZYX",  data: { psi:0, theta: Math.PI/2, phi:0 } },
  };

  document.querySelectorAll(".rc-preset-btn").forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
      const p = PRESETS[btn.dataset.preset];
      if (!p) return;
      const result = RC.convert(p.data, p.rep);
      currentResult = result;
      activeRep = p.rep;
      populateAllPanels(result);
      buildFormulaText(result, p.rep);
      updateViz(result);
    });
  });

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   * THREE.JS SCREW AXIS VISUALISER
   * ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  let vizScene, vizCamera, vizRenderer, vizControls;
  let vizAxisArrow, vizArcLine, vizFrame0, vizFrameR;
  const VIZ_AXIS_LEN   = 1.0;
  const VIZ_SCREW_LEN  = 1.4;
  const VIZ_FRAME_LEN  = 0.7;
  const VIZ_ARC_SEGS   = 64;

  function initViz() {
    const canvas = $("rc-canvas");
    if (!window.THREE) {
      $("rc-webgl-fallback").style.display = "block";
      canvas.style.display = "none";
      return;
    }
    const THREE = window.THREE;

    vizRenderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ canvas, antialias: true, alpha: false });
    vizRenderer.setPixelRatio(window.devicePixelRatio);
    vizRenderer.setClearColor(0x0a0a14, 1);

    vizScene = new THREE.Scene();
    vizScene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.6));
    const dirLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.8);
    dirLight.position.set(3, 5, 3);
    vizScene.add(dirLight);

    const w = canvas.clientWidth, h = canvas.clientHeight || 450;
    vizCamera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(40, w / h, 0.01, 100);
    vizCamera.position.set(2.2, 1.8, 2.2);
    vizCamera.lookAt(0, 0, 0);

    if (window.THREE.OrbitControls) {
      vizControls = new THREE.OrbitControls(vizCamera, vizRenderer.domElement);
      vizControls.enableDamping = true;
      vizControls.dampingFactor = 0.08;
      vizControls.target.set(0, 0, 0);
    }

    // Grid
    const grid = new THREE.GridHelper(4, 8, 0x222233, 0x1a1a2e);
    vizScene.add(grid);

    // World frame axes
    vizFrame0 = makeCoordFrame(VIZ_FRAME_LEN, [0xff4444, 0x44ff44, 0x4488ff], 3);
    vizScene.add(vizFrame0);

    // Axis labels
    addAxisLabel("X", [VIZ_FRAME_LEN + 0.12, 0, 0], 0xff4444);
    addAxisLabel("Y", [0, VIZ_FRAME_LEN + 0.12, 0], 0x44ff44);
    addAxisLabel("Z", [0, 0, VIZ_FRAME_LEN + 0.12], 0x4488ff);

    // Rotated frame (updated each frame)
    vizFrameR = makeCoordFrame(VIZ_FRAME_LEN, [0xff8888, 0x88ff88, 0x88aaff], 2, true);
    vizScene.add(vizFrameR);

    // Screw axis placeholder
    vizAxisArrow = makeArrow([0,0,0], [0,1,0], VIZ_SCREW_LEN, 0xfbbf24, 0.025, 0.08);
    vizScene.add(vizAxisArrow);

    // Arc placeholder
    vizArcLine = makeArc([0,0,1], 0, 0.5, VIZ_ARC_SEGS);
    vizScene.add(vizArcLine);

    // Origin dot
    const dotGeo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.03, 12, 8);
    const dotMat = new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({ color: 0xffffff });
    vizScene.add(new THREE.Mesh(dotGeo, dotMat));

    // Resize observer
    new ResizeObserver(() => resizeViz()).observe(canvas);

    requestAnimationFrame(animateViz);
  }

  function resizeViz() {
    const canvas = $("rc-canvas");
    if (!vizRenderer || !canvas) return;
    const w = canvas.clientWidth, h = canvas.clientHeight || 450;
    vizRenderer.setSize(w, h, false);
    vizCamera.aspect = w / h;
    vizCamera.updateProjectionMatrix();
  }

  function animateViz() {
    requestAnimationFrame(animateViz);
    if (vizControls) vizControls.update();
    if (vizRenderer) vizRenderer.render(vizScene, vizCamera);
  }

  /** Update the screw axis arrow and rotated frame from a convert() result. */
  function updateViz(result) {
    if (!vizScene || !window.THREE) return;
    const THREE = window.THREE;
    const { R, axisAngle } = result;
    const { axis, angle } = axisAngle;

    /* Rotated frame — apply R to each basis vector */
    updateCoordFrame(vizFrameR, R);

    /* Screw axis arrow */
    vizScene.remove(vizAxisArrow);
    const axisDir = Math.abs(angle) < 1e-8 ? [0,1,0] : axis;
    vizAxisArrow = makeArrow(
      axisDir.map(v => -v * VIZ_SCREW_LEN * 0.5),  // center the arrow at origin
      axisDir, VIZ_SCREW_LEN, 0xfbbf24, 0.018, 0.07
    );
    vizScene.add(vizAxisArrow);

    /* Rotation arc */
    vizScene.remove(vizArcLine);
    if (Math.abs(angle) > 1e-4) {
      vizArcLine = makeArc(axisDir, angle, VIZ_FRAME_LEN * 0.85, VIZ_ARC_SEGS);
      vizScene.add(vizArcLine);
    }

    /* Info label */
    const th = angleDeg ? RC.rad2deg(angle).toFixed(2) + "°" : angle.toFixed(4) + " rad";
    $("rc-viz-info").textContent = Math.abs(angle) < 1e-8
      ? "Identity (θ = 0)"
      : `n̂ = [${axis.map(v=>v.toFixed(3)).join(", ")}]   θ = ${th}`;
  }

  /* ── Three.js geometry builders ─────────────────────────────────────────── */

  /** Create a coordinate frame as a group of three arrow helpers. */
  function makeCoordFrame(length, colors, lineW, dashed = false) {
    const THREE = window.THREE;
    const group = new THREE.Group();
    const dirs = [[1,0,0],[0,1,0],[0,0,1]];
    dirs.forEach((d, i) => {
      const mat = new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color: colors[i], linewidth: lineW });
      const pts = [new THREE.Vector3(0,0,0), new THREE.Vector3(...d.map(v=>v*length))];
      const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(pts);
      group.add(new THREE.Line(geo, mat));
      // Arrowhead cone
      const coneH = length * 0.14, coneR = length * 0.04;
      const coneGeo = new THREE.ConeGeometry(coneR, coneH, 8);
      const coneMat = new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({ color: colors[i] });
      const cone = new THREE.Mesh(coneGeo, coneMat);
      cone.position.set(...d.map(v=>v*(length + coneH/2)));
      cone.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(new THREE.Vector3(0,1,0), new THREE.Vector3(...d));
      group.add(cone);
    });
    return group;
  }

  /** Build or rebuild an arrow from origin+direction. */
  function makeArrow(origin, dir, length, color, shaftR, headR) {
    const THREE = window.THREE;
    const group = new THREE.Group();
    const d = new THREE.Vector3(...dir).normalize();
    const o = new THREE.Vector3(...origin);

    // Shaft
    const shaftH = length * 0.82;
    const shaftGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(shaftR, shaftR, shaftH, 12);
    const shaftMat = new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({ color });
    const shaft = new THREE.Mesh(shaftGeo, shaftMat);
    shaft.position.copy(o).addScaledVector(d, shaftH / 2);
    shaft.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(new THREE.Vector3(0,1,0), d);
    group.add(shaft);

    // Head
    const headH = length * 0.18;
    const headGeo = new THREE.ConeGeometry(headR, headH, 12);
    const headMat = new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({ color });
    const head = new THREE.Mesh(headGeo, headMat);
    head.position.copy(o).addScaledVector(d, shaftH + headH / 2);
    head.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(new THREE.Vector3(0,1,0), d);
    group.add(head);

    return group;
  }

  /** Build a circular arc in the plane perpendicular to axis, radius r, swept angle θ. */
  function makeArc(axis, angle, radius, segments) {
    const THREE = window.THREE;
    const n = new THREE.Vector3(...axis).normalize();
    // Find a perpendicular vector
    const ref = Math.abs(n.x) < 0.9 ? new THREE.Vector3(1,0,0) : new THREE.Vector3(0,1,0);
    const u = ref.clone().sub(n.clone().multiplyScalar(n.dot(ref))).normalize();
    const v = n.clone().cross(u);

    const pts = [];
    const steps = Math.max(4, Math.ceil(Math.abs(angle) / (2*Math.PI) * segments));
    for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i++) {
      const t = (i / steps) * angle;
      const p = u.clone().multiplyScalar(Math.cos(t) * radius)
                 .addScaledVector(v, Math.sin(t) * radius);
      pts.push(p);
    }
    const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(pts);
    const mat = new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color: 0xfbbf24, linewidth: 2 });
    return new THREE.Line(geo, mat);
  }

  /** Update a coord-frame group's basis vectors using rotation matrix R (row-major). */
  function updateCoordFrame(group, R) {
    const THREE = window.THREE;
    // R maps body frame to world: column i of R is the image of eᵢ
    // children: 0,1,2 = x,y,z lines; 3,4,5 = x,y,z cones
    const dirs = [
      [R[0], R[3], R[6]],  // image of ex  (column 0 of R)
      [R[1], R[4], R[7]],  // image of ey
      [R[2], R[5], R[8]],  // image of ez
    ];
    const L = VIZ_FRAME_LEN;
    group.children.forEach((child, ci) => {
      const axIdx = Math.floor(ci / 2);
      const isLine = ci % 2 === 0;
      const d = new THREE.Vector3(...dirs[axIdx]);
      if (isLine) {
        const pos = child.geometry.attributes.position;
        pos.setXYZ(1, d.x*L, d.y*L, d.z*L);
        pos.needsUpdate = true;
      } else {
        const coneH = L * 0.14;
        child.position.set(...d.toArray().map(v=>v*(L + coneH/2)));
        child.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(new THREE.Vector3(0,1,0), d);
      }
    });
  }

  /** Add a canvas-sprite text label at position [x,y,z]. */
  function addAxisLabel(text, pos, color) {
    if (!window.THREE) return;
    const THREE = window.THREE;
    const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
    canvas.width = 64; canvas.height = 64;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
    ctx.fillStyle = "#" + color.toString(16).padStart(6,"0");
    ctx.font = "bold 48px sans-serif";
    ctx.textAlign = "center"; ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.fillText(text, 32, 32);
    const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
    const mat = new THREE.SpriteMaterial({ map: tex, transparent: true });
    const sprite = new THREE.Sprite(mat);
    sprite.position.set(...pos);
    sprite.scale.set(0.22, 0.22, 1);
    vizScene.add(sprite);
  }

  /* ── Boot ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
    initViz();
    resizeViz();
    update();   // populate with identity
  });

})();
</script>
```

---

## Mathematical Reference

### Rodrigues Formula (Axis-Angle → R)

Given unit axis $\hat{\mathbf{n}}$ and angle $\theta$:

$$R = I + \sin\theta \,[\hat{\mathbf{n}}]_\times + (1-\cos\theta)\,[\hat{\mathbf{n}}]_\times^2$$

where the skew-symmetric matrix is

$$[\hat{\mathbf{n}}]_\times = \begin{bmatrix}0 & -n_z & n_y \\ n_z & 0 & -n_x \\ -n_y & n_x & 0\end{bmatrix}.$$

### Rotation Matrix → Axis-Angle

$$\theta = \arccos\!\left(\frac{\operatorname{tr}(R)-1}{2}\right), \qquad \hat{\mathbf{n}} = \frac{1}{2\sin\theta}\begin{bmatrix}R_{32}-R_{23}\\R_{13}-R_{31}\\R_{21}-R_{12}\end{bmatrix}.$$

Special cases: $\theta = 0$ (identity, axis undefined) and $\theta = \pi$ (180° rotation, Shepperd's method on diagonal).

### Rotation Matrix → Quaternion (Shepperd)

$$w = \tfrac{1}{2}\sqrt{1+\operatorname{tr}(R)}, \quad x = \frac{R_{32}-R_{23}}{4w}, \quad y = \frac{R_{13}-R_{31}}{4w}, \quad z = \frac{R_{21}-R_{12}}{4w}.$$

At $\theta = 180°$ (where $w \approx 0$) the formula is numerically degenerate; the implementation uses the diagonal entries of $(R+I)/2$ instead.

### Quaternion → Rotation Matrix

$$R = \begin{bmatrix}1-2(y^2+z^2) & 2(xy-wz) & 2(xz+wy) \\ 2(xy+wz) & 1-2(x^2+z^2) & 2(yz-wx) \\ 2(xz-wy) & 2(yz+wx) & 1-2(x^2+y^2)\end{bmatrix}.$$

Both $\mathbf{q}$ and $-\mathbf{q}$ produce identical $R$ (double cover of $SO(3)$).

### ZYX Euler Angles

Composition order: $R = R_z(\psi) R_y(\theta) R_x(\phi)$.  Extraction:

$$\psi = \operatorname{atan2}(R_{21}, R_{11}), \quad \theta = -\arcsin(R_{31}), \quad \phi = \operatorname{atan2}(R_{32}, R_{33}).$$

**Gimbal lock** occurs when $\theta = \pm 90°$ ($R_{31} = \mp 1$). In that configuration $\psi$ and $\phi$ cannot be independently resolved; the implementation sets $\phi = 0$ and encodes all remaining rotation in $\psi$.

### Exponential Coordinates

$\boldsymbol{\omega} = \theta\hat{\mathbf{n}} \in \mathbb{R}^3$. The magnitude $|\boldsymbol{\omega}| = \theta$ is the rotation angle; the direction $\hat{\mathbf{n}} = \boldsymbol{\omega}/\theta$ is the screw axis. These are the coordinates of the Lie algebra $\mathfrak{so}(3)$:

$$R = \exp([\boldsymbol{\omega}]_\times).$$

---

**See also:** [Rotation Representations Reference](rotation-representations-reference.html) — full derivations and Python implementation.
[Screw Theory Reference](screw-theory-reference.html) — SE(3) twists, wrenches, and product of exponentials.
